title: Find the deforestation rate for Rondonia
method: Buffer all 27 662 road segments by 5.5 km and dissolve (164 936 km2, South America Albers Equal Area ESRI:102033); intersect with the deforested area (made valid); percentage_deforestation = 100 * deforested area inside the buffer / buffer area = 47.55 %. The overlay is exact but done in 24 x 24 tiles for speed.
benchmark_defects: The published reference script uses overlay how='difference', so the area it divides by the buffer area is the part of the buffer outside the deforested polygons.
Whether the value is a percentage (0-100) or a fraction is not specified (the published reference script writes a fraction in a column named 'percentage_deforestation'); both are accepted.
The deforested multipolygon is invalid (needs make_valid/buffer(0)) and very large; a naive global overlay with 27 662 buffers takes many minutes.
The published reference script projects both layers to UTM zone 23S (EPSG:32723).
checks: required: column percentage_deforestation (case-insensitive) with a numeric value
required: value within 1.5 percentage points of the gold (47.55 %); values <= 1 read as fractions
